[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] '''Deffan''' was an individual in command of [[Wetyin's Colony (planet)|Wetyin's Colony]]. The [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Lile Gorsek]] reported to Deffan on the suitability of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] as the new site for the Colony.
